facts.fact: Palava Innovations, self-reporting to the MFDP dashboard, lists its AI health platform (status Implementation, 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31) as including an offline symptom checker with on-device condition classifier and severity predictor models.

systems.platform: mobile app with offline symptom checker and SMS/USSD triage

LBR.note: Self-reported, self-funded company platform; no public health system is stated to use it.
No training for civil servants is stated.
No government rural connectivity programme or rural-urban internet figures are stated.
A company's app education module, not a government programme with a stated count.
No school internet figure or curriculum rule is stated.
